name: Mistral Nemo Instruct 2407
definition: Mistral Nemo Instruct 2407 is a dense multilingual instruction model developed by Mistral AI / NVIDIA in the Mistral NeMo family. It has 12B parameters, supports 128K tokens of context, accepts Text / code and produces Text / code. Its primary role is multilingual assistants, code and long-context text workloads.

key_topics: multilingual assistants, code and long-context text workloads

details: 32 attention heads / 8 KV heads using GQA

training.summary: Mistral NeMo was trained jointly by Mistral AI and NVIDIA with a large proportion of multilingual and code data. The instruct model is the aligned variant and was presented as a drop-in replacement for Mistral 7B-class deployments that need stronger multilingual performance.

deployments.notes: Model is tagged for vLLM serving.

hardware.summary: A 12B dense model is comparatively approachable: BF16 still needs substantial memory, while 8-bit/4-bit builds can fit higher-end consumer hardware. Long 128K sessions add cache overhead independent of weight size.

limitations: 128K context creates memory/latency costs not visible from the 12B parameter count.
The model card highlights nine languages; broader language use should be evaluated.
Older 2024 model may have weaker agent/tool conventions than newer Mistral families.
Text/code only; no native image or audio input.
